scope: Concise scientific decisions with complete results indexed separately. Pilot selection evidence is not independent confirmation.
rules: Register a new scientific question or an explicit reason before repeating a completed cell.
A repeat needs a referenced prior ID and a concrete change, correction, unfinished cell, or prespecified independent confirmation.
Preserve failed and partial experiments plus historical source receipts. Do not silently replace an earlier conclusion.
Each new substantive experiment records exact method/data/source/config/seed/resource bindings in its native receipt and concise outcome here.
Native author execution, mathematical adaptations, published-task reproduction and common-data comparisons remain distinct.
metric_warning: Reported source metrics retain their original scope. Different studies, panels, inference pipelines or model information access are not interchangeable. No automatic cross-study ranking.

decisions.hypothesis: Initial ordered lineage networks improve the easy oracle panel
decisions.method: Initial graph/set/GRU/Transformer/supra/lineage variants, two seeds, 16 TRAIN/4 VAL/8 historical pilot TEST parents.
decisions.conclusion: The nearest-TMRCA oracle comparator reached 98.10% grid accuracy. Initial neural models were much weaker. This panel does not support an ancestry improvement claim.
decisions.repeat_policy: Do not rerun unchanged. Reopen only for a corrected encoder or a demonstrably harder inferred-tree task.

decisions.hypothesis: Reference reachability explains weak initial graph encoders
decisions.method: Reference-feature and genealogy-aware encoders on ancient oracle and paired inferred Q8 panels.
decisions.conclusion: Reference-aware controls improved the engineering comparison. Ordered-lineage novelty and superiority remain unsupported.
decisions.repeat_policy: Revisit only for a concrete input-reachability defect or new biological benchmark.

decisions.hypothesis: Boundary memory beats all-record temporal controls
decisions.method: Boundary full/diagonal/gain controls and GNN+GRU/Transformer, Q64 inferred pilot.
decisions.conclusion: Boundary full NLL 1.038652 versus GRU 1.038243. It did not consistently beat temporal controls on reused validation parents.
decisions.repeat_policy: Do not repeat the same seed/config/cohort. A new model mechanism or independent biological confirmation needs a new entry.

decisions.hypothesis: Fixed-anchor cross-query geometry helps compared with diagonal decay
decisions.method: Nine plain anchor variants on 16 TRAIN/4 reused VAL Q64 inferred parents, seed101.
decisions.conclusion: Full depth2 NLL 1.025647 versus scalar 1.038708, diagonal 1.039765 and gain-matched diagonal 1.040722. These are exploratory selected scores.
decisions.repeat_policy: Independent parents/seeds and full-information competitors can confirm or reject this observation. No unchanged pilot rerun.

decisions.hypothesis: Query-source feedback explains the fixed-anchor result
decisions.method: Capacity-matched noncontextual/static controls, same Q64 parents/seed101.
decisions.conclusion: Full depth2 NLL 1.025647 and noncontextual depth2 1.026034 are nearly equal. Static depth2 NLL 1.117582 supports a sequence-information benefit in this pilot.
decisions.repeat_policy: Do not assert a feedback contribution. Reopen only with a specific changed feedback mechanism or independent prespecified confirmation.

decisions.hypothesis: Age-conditioned graph geometry improves ancestry prediction
decisions.method: Full age versus matched scalar-age, depth1/2, same reused Q64 validation parents/seed101.
decisions.conclusion: Age full depth2 NLL 1.023317 versus scalar-age full depth2 1.025001. The difference is small and unconfirmed. Geometry audits alone are not prediction evidence.
decisions.repeat_policy: Independent biological evaluation can test this. Remaining scalar-age ablations are distinct unfinished cells, not reruns.

decisions.hypothesis: Anchor kernel improves over matched temporal layers
decisions.method: Same source encoder/anchors, GRU/Transformer and reference smoothing, Q64 seed101.
decisions.conclusion: Age full depth2 accuracy 53.7170% versus matched anchor GRU 53.0029% and Transformer 52.1454%. Scopes differ because the candidate propagates intervening geometry holds.
decisions.repeat_policy: Confirm with all-record competitors, independent parents and a frozen biological task. Shared data alone does not equal shared information access.

decisions.hypothesis: The kernel shows a broad cross-domain predictive advantage
